ambiguities: In the death-notice exchange, Mme de Cambremer corrects the princesse de Malte's dating of the marquise d'Arpajon's death with a specific personal recollection ('j'ai été à une soirée de musique chez elle il y a moins d'un an'), which could be read as a quiet display of social/rhetorical competence contrasting with Bloch's already-scored exclusion from the discussion. This was not scored because the exchange functions as neutral illustrative dialogue for the narrator's essayistic point about mortality becoming trivial among the aged and their milieu, rather than as a marked evaluation of Mme de Cambremer herself.
